steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Everyone, are you getting all fired up?!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: In order to welcome the hottest concert in the Obsidian Festival...

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Starting from 12 o'clock today, all the malls, recreational facilities, and even some of your favorite bars and restaurants will hold a variety of warm-up activities!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: You do not want to miss out!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I knew you'd come here, milady.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Schwarz...

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I knew you'd come here. After Cronin turned you down, you'd try to use the broadcast tower to spread the news so that the entire city would hear it.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: This won't work, milady. It will only cause confusion and chaos.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Perhaps you hate your father and this city, but Master Doykos has already given enough. This will lead to the demise of the Obsidian Festival and Siesta as a whole.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I know that the news will cause an uproar and maybe even have far-reaching consequences, but the truth needs to be heard.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I know Master Doykos has made mistakes in the past. Though he has done a lot of wrong, Siesta would not exist were it not for his actions.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: This has nothing to do with that!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Feel free to criticize me if you must, but please do not do something that is beyond redemption.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Do you... do you really think I'm just some child throwing a temper tantrum?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: No, milady. I'll try to persuade Master Doykos, I promise you. But just for now, let's head back together.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Schwarz... Don't talk to me like that.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I know you and Master Doykos currently do not see eye to eye, but for the time being, you should head home first.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I told you not to talk to me like that! I know that you're trying to mend our relationship, but could you not be like that?!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Why can't you treat me like you used to? Talk to me as a friend, Schwarz!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I am simply a servant of the Doykos family.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Don't say that, Schwarz. I don't want to hear you talk like that! What happened to you? Why would you treat me like this?

steps.name: Cronin's Henchman
steps.text: What are you doing? Seize her this instant!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...She is the master's daughter. Watch your words.

steps.name: Cronin's Henchman
steps.text: But the mayor told you to give your full support to Mister Cronin! Are you going to let her destroy Siesta with her poisonous rumors?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Use your brain for a moment. She came here alone, without even the slightest show of anxiety...

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Do you really think she's trying to enter the broadcast tower?

steps.name: Cronin's Henchman
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Forget it.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Milady, you're using yourself to distract me, right?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: ...You still know me well.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I wouldn't say that, milady. But since you didn't deny it, I can surmise as much.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Right now, Rhodes Island should already be at the City Hall.

steps.name: Cronin's Henchman
steps.text: Wh-what?! That's not a part of the plan! What's going on at the City Hall?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I'd assume the thugs over there are getting a good beating just about now.

steps.name: Cronin's Bodyguard
steps.text: Why's it so quiet out there? I told them to hurry up and carry the materials away. They dare slack off on such an urgent task?

steps.name: Cronin's Bodyguard
steps.text: Hmm? What was that noise? Did another fight break out? Whatever, I need to finish that task...

steps.name: Girl's Voice
steps.text: Sir, please open the door! We have a package to deliver!

steps.name: Cronin's Bodyguard
steps.text: (Huh? Did any of you order something?)

steps.name: Cronin's Bodyguard
steps.text: (No? That's weird...)

steps.name: Cronin's Bodyguard
steps.text: You've got the wrong address!

steps.name: Girl's Voice
steps.text: But sir, the label on the parcel says it's right here...?

steps.name: Cronin's Bodyguard
steps.text: Get lost! If you keep bothering us, I'm gonna teach you a lesson!

steps.name: Cronin's Bodyguard
steps.text: Tsk... Sly little devil, trying to trick us again.

steps.name: Girl's Voice
steps.text: Ah, screw it! Doctor, stand aside, I'm kicking the door down!

steps.name: Girl's Voice
steps.text: What?! Don't worry! I'm more than strong enough!

steps.name: Cronin's Bodyguard
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Hah!

steps.name: Cronin's Bodyguard
steps.text: Whaaaat?! The main door...! My god, what kind of monster are you—

options: Friends, you mustn't be so rude to the courier.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Hehe, I've always wanted to give that a try. And now, there's this line...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Um, ahem!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: 'FBI! Open up!'

options: But you already kicked the door down...
